slate_lookat.settings.group.plate.about: A small plate beside the crosshair while it is on a mob or a player within your reach: who that is and how they are. It keeps off the crosshair and off the mob's head, stays for a moment after you look away, and hides with the HUD (F1), while a screen is open and in spectator mode.
slate_lookat.settings.group.lines.about: Only what your game knows by itself, with nothing needed on the server. A line with nothing to say is left out.
slate_lookat.settings.enabled.tip: Shows the plate while the crosshair is on a mob or a player you could hit.
slate_lookat.settings.left_to.tip: %s says what you look at itself, so Slate's plate stands back. Switch "Leave it to other mods" off to see both.
slate_lookat.settings.yieldToMods.tip: With Jade, WTHIT, The One Probe or Insight installed, that mod says what you look at and Slate's plate does not show. Off: Slate's plate shows as well.
slate_lookat.settings.portrait.tip: Draws the mob small at the head of its plate, as it is at that moment: the head and shoulders of something tall, the whole of anything else. A mod's mob that cannot be drawn this way gets its plate without it.
slate_lookat.settings.name: Name
slate_lookat.settings.name.tip: What its name tag would say: the name somebody gave it, a player's name, or else what kind of mob it is.
slate_lookat.settings.kind.tip: Under a name somebody gave it, what kind of mob it is; under a player's name, "Player".
slate_lookat.settings.health.tip: A bar with its number: health points, two to a heart, of the most it can have. A player's absorption follows in gold. What a hit takes stays up pale for a moment.
slate_lookat.settings.armor.tip: Its armour points, while it has any: what it wears and what it has by nature.
slate_lookat.settings.baby.tip: A small "Baby" chip beside the name of a young animal, villager or monster.
slate_lookat.settings.owner.tip: Whose a tamed animal is, where your game is told: a wolf's, a cat's or a parrot's owner while that player is online. Of a horse it is only told that it is tamed.
slate_lookat.settings.villager.tip: A villager's level, from Novice to Master. For a zombie villager also the profession it had.
slate_lookat.settings.mount.tip: How fast a horse, a donkey or a mule runs (blocks a second, at a gallop) and how high it jumps (blocks, at full charge), as it was born: worked out from its two attributes the way the game moves it.
slate_lookat.settings.effects.tip: The effects your game has been told of, as icons. A server that runs nothing but the game tells you only of the animal you ride, so this row is mostly empty there.
